text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On our way back from an outing with Yamanin Zephyr, a familiar face called out to us.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! It's Zephyr!
Were you out hanging out with your trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
To feel the twilight and the evening sun.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice... Turbo and the others
came back because we couldn't go camping...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey there. Man, Turbo wasn't kidding.
The campsite is crazy packed...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It was my fault for not making a reservation
just because it was day camping. I completely
underestimated the recent craze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That was unfortunate with the wind...
Even though it would have been perfect weather for camping.
choice_data_list: Maybe Zephyr knows a hidden gem of a spot?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... If you don't mind that it's not
as well-equipped as a regular campsite,
shall I show you the way?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Please do~! If it has Zephyr's stamp of approval, we might actually be able to do some real camping!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The place Yamanin Zephyr guided me to was, quite literally, a hidden-gem mountain stream!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's a river! And there's a waterfall over there!
Awesome, awesome! This feels just like real camping!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is my favorite spot.
I thought we could spend a moment taking in the spring breeze.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, I came empty-handed.
I originally planned on renting things on-site... I should have at least brought a picnic mat.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry.
The forest provides everything we need.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr gathered up fallen leafy twigs and skillfully layered them together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...It is a green sheet.
The spring of the branches and softness of the leaves are quite pleasant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without delay, we each made our own green mats.
Layering them so the branches didn't get in the way took a bit of knack, but it wasn't difficult.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And... finished! Oh, it looks pretty
comfortable to sit on too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: This has way better cushioning than a picnic mat, it's great!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! I picked a bunch of berries and nuts!
They said we can eat them raw!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "I've drawn some spring water, so I'll brew some tea. Please, join me."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... A subtle sweetness amidst just the right amount of astringency.
What a gentle, flavorful wild berry...!
choice_data_list: The tea is refreshing and delicious too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh? Zephyr-san?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hup...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Suddenly heading toward the river, Yamanin Zephyr stepped right in without hesitation and plunged both hands into the water!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa!
What are you doing all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Since it's lunchtime, I thought I'd try
to catch some wandering fish...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, seriously, don't overdo it!
You're completely soaked!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's a feathered fan.
I use it all the time, so please, don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Matching wits with the fish is the best part of camping. I won't lose next time... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: That looks so fun!! Turbo's gonna go catch some fish too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, indeed.
Salt-grilled, freshly caught fish is a camping specialty.
I'll help out too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well, how can I say no to exquisite gourmet food?
I'm coming too! I'm totally coming!
...Hup!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Wait, waaaait~!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo!
Just like that... over here... hup!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oooooh! Nice catch, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, we did it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having fully enjoyed camping the Yamanin Zephyr way, we headed home.
—Saying goodbye to everyone in front of the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Before we knew it, the evening calm had settled in.
It seems everyone has gotten quite exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's fun...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
I usually feel the wind alone when camping, but today's breeze—felt remarkably refreshing.
choice_data_list: Do you want to come here with everyone again?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Enjoying the refreshing breeze with someone from time to time
might be quite nice as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if anything, it was still quite Japanese.
I felt we could have stayed a bit longer.
choice_data_list: We'll continue this next time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Maybe next time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr stood there for a moment, quietly taking in the meaning of those words. I felt as though a small change was beginning to take root within her.
